sourceSentences: Enemies in the epicenter take 66.7% increased damage and are slow [slowed] by a greater amount, decaying to 25% over the duration.
Xerath's location gets sight [revealed] to the enemy (400 radius for 4.5 seconds) if Eye of Destruction's cast location is within 100 units of a valid enemy at the start of the cast time
Xerath channel [charges] while being slow [slowed] for up to 3 seconds to increase Arcanopulse's range
If the charge is interrupt [interrupted] or completes without reactivation, Arcanopulse is cancelled and refunds mana [half the mana cost].
Q charge table: spells=true, true (Flash usable). Recast delay lockout table: spells=true,false (Flash disabled).
Shocking Orb deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and stuns them for [orb travel distance] seconds. (Effect at cast time end)
If Rite of the Arcane ends without any of the recasts being used, half of its cooldown is refunded.
After catapulting the first missile, Xerath will sight [reveal] himself while there are enemy champions within Rite of the Arcane's range.
Arcane Barrage will not apply its increased damage per stack to the cast that granted the stack.
R channel table: attack=interrupts, move=Disabled for the first 1.25 seconds, otherwise, interrupts, spells=true, false (Flash disabled)
Periodically, Xerath empowers his next basic attack on-hit to restore mana, doubled against enemy champions.
Mana Surge's cooldown is reduced by 3.5 seconds whenever Xerath kills an enemy. Mana Surge does not trigger if Xerath would restore above his maximum mana.
If you do see a kill opportunity, again, you just do a W into E.
one of my favorite combos is just W when they're super low into R.
all you're going to do is you're going to press your stun ability and then flash sideways. And so what that does, it changes where your E
one of the most iconic ones is just charging your Q, flashing, and then letting go your Q. You cannot let go your Q, then flash. It does not work.
Use W into Q for reliable poke. Use W into E when you need the stun
The farther E travels, the longer it stuns, making this most reliable from medium or long range.
Once it connects, center the W directly on the stun target, then finish with Q before they can escape.
charge Q, then flash before releasing it to extend its reach
You can also use flash to change the firing angle.
Cast E, then flash during its brief cast animation. The projectile launches from Zerath's new position, changing its starting point and angle while unexpectedly extending its reach.
Charging only increases its range, not its damage.
Continue holding Q without releasing it. Allow the charge to expire, and half of its mana cost will be refunded.
Moving or issuing an attack command immediately cancels the channel.
If you cancel before firing a blast, half of its ultimate cool down is refunded, making the bait far less costly.
Once Sarah starts firing, enemies within range can see his location
If E connects from far enough away, immediately activate your ultimate and fire. W can also set this up.
Every unit Zerat kills reduces the passive's remaining cool down
